scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to monotone log-concave integer laws with two through five support points. It does not determine the six-point or larger constants, where additional mean cells can become active. The proof is analytic; the standalone checker is supplemental. The closest general finite-support localization theorem and direct mean-mode inequality were explicitly compared. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Sharp mean–mode constants for monotone log-concave laws on at most five atoms
